Package com.ceichhorst.reservation.controller

Class HomeServlet

  • java.lang.Object
    • jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
      • jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
        • com.ceichhorst.reservation.controller.HomeServlet
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable
    @WebServlet("/r/*")
public class HomeServlet
extends jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
    Servlet responsible for handling requests to the public-facing home page of the reservation platform.

    This servlet serves a restaurant-specific home page using a path-based routing scheme. Each request is scoped to a particular Restaurant, identified by an ID embedded in the URL.

    URL format:

       /r/{restaurantId}

    Example:

    • /r/1 → Loads the home page for restaurant with ID 1

    • Method Detail

      • doGet

        protected void doGet​(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request,
                     jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response)
              throws jakarta.servlet.ServletException,
                     IOException
        Handles HTTP GET requests for restaurant-specific home page.

        This method performs the following steps:

        1. Parses the restaurant ID from the request path
        2. Retrieves the associated Restaurant and its ServiceInstances
        3. Filters out non-visible services
        4. If a date parameter is provided, computes available time slots
        5. Formats service times for display
        6. Builds a calendar view of availability
        7. Stores relevant data in request and session attributes
        8. Forwards the request to the JSP view for rendering

        Request attributes set:

        • restaurant → the current Restaurant
        • services → all visible ServiceInstances
        • availableTimes → filtered available time slots for selected date
        • calendar → list of DayAvailability objects
        • selectedDate → the selected date (if provided)

        Session attributes set:

        • restaurant → cached restaurant object
        • lastRestaurantId → last accessed restaurant ID
        Overrides:
        doGet in class jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
        Parameters:
        request - the HTTP request
        response - the HTTP response
        Throws:
        jakarta.servlet.ServletException - if request forwarding fails
        IOException - if an I/O error occurs
